comment: BytO installs C–N biaryl linkage in the myxarylin biosynthesis and also demonstrated broad substrate tolerance

reactions.description: BytO catalyzes C–N biaryl cross-link between histidine and tyrosine of precursor peptide (MNYLH)
BytO catalyzes C–N biaryl cross-link within the BytA precursor peptide (MNYLH), generating the characteristic bicyclic scaffold of myxarylin
